answer: By combining zero-knowledge verifiable delays with quadratic slashing of staking collateral, our protocol forces marginal attack costs to scale super-linearly. Any attempt to exploit an isolated island of validators yields only a hollow victory of negative expected utility. As malicious participation increases, the slashing penalties rise to a quantitative zenith, guaranteeing that the capital expenditure of an attack far exceeds any extractable value and thereby securing a robust Nash equilibrium.
